title: Bind sensor as a point
name: Name
phaseGroupHint: All current channels of the module become one 3-phase point: the sum and each phase's readings. Phase “3P” is set automatically.
haAfterReboot: Home Assistant entities for the new point appear after the hub restarts.
ratedHelper: optional — for the line load bar
pointHelper: Latin letters, digits, «_ . -». Empty — the hub derives it from the name. Home Assistant and MQTT know the point by it.
pointTaken: ID «{point}» is already used by another point.
tombstones: IDs of removed points — can be reused:
reuseWarn: ID «{point}» belonged to a removed point. Its history on the hub starts afresh — the old one was deleted on unbind. Home Assistant and MQTT know the point by its ID and will continue its old history as one point. If the channel now feeds a different load, give it a new ID.
liveOnly: This point will show live values only: the hub keeps history for {n} points.
